verdict.rationale: The 01 is an open-source agent platform with a server and clients, so letting users issue scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack documents no API keys, tokens, permission scopes, or credential management. Profile customization (behavior, model, system message) is an adjacent configuration feature, not scoped credential issuance, and the OpenAPI probe found no published API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
